integrity: An analytic finite-dimensional argument proves the classification for every integer shore size at least three and every positive real screening; exact rational enumeration is a supplementary finite check, not an infinite proof. Source comparisons are limited to inspected materials; independent validation was not performed.
scientific_limitations: Only unweighted balanced complete bipartite graphs with both shores of size at least three, positive scalar screening, exactly three independent class-supported Rademacher probes, and variance (not runtime or tail risk); no unbalanced graph, other probe budget, or correlated probes are claimed.
title: A sharp mixed-class transition in three-probe trace estimation on balanced bicliques
